svg.title: Input cost and total process CPU
svg.desc: Separate zero-based panels compare synchronous send cost and total process CPU for a 100,000-value burst. Medians of 15 rounds; CPU includes output and settling. Task per value versus long-lived task: 798 versus 216 ns/send, about 73% lower, and 280.81 versus 21.91 ms CPU, about 92% lower.
